welcome.title: A tour of the upload
welcome.text: Two things to give: the file and what the gel is read for. A one-minute tour; Esc leaves it, the Tour compass at the top brings it back.

steps.title: The file
steps.text: Drop it here, or click to browse: a scanner file (.gel, .scn), a TIFF, PNG or JPEG, up to 100 MB.

steps.title: What the gel is read for
steps.text: The assay decides what the analysis page and the densitometry report: a purity on an SDS-PAGE, the variants of the molecule or the host-cell proteins on a western blot.

steps.title: The gel type
steps.text: SDS-PAGE, dot blot or western blot. With an assay chosen it follows the assay; without one, the gel is read from this type.

steps.title: Upload
steps.text: You land on the image's page, where New analysis starts reading it.
